species.description: Its species, such as 'Orcinus orca'; empty above species level.

start_date.description: The first day of 'event_date', as YYYY-MM-DD.

taxon_rank.description: The rank of the name, such as 'Species'.

vernacular_name.description: A common name the publisher gave, such as 'Killer whale'.

water_body.description: The sea or ocean, as the publisher named it.

year.description: The year it was seen or sampled.

total.description: How many match in all, across every page.

description: Explore OBIS, UNESCO's open database of 230 million records of where and when marine species were seen or sampled. Search occurrence records by species, sea area, depth, dates or a map box, list the species and the threatened or newly recorded ones in an area, find and read datasets, count records by year, temperature or any field, and run a workflow when new records of a species or a new dataset arrive. No account or API key required.

obis_new_dataset_trigger.description: Runs when a dataset is added to OBIS, optionally only from one OBIS node, with its title, citation, license, nodes and record counts.

output.absence_records: How many of its records are absences.
output.abstract: What it holds, as plain text.
output.added_at: When it was first added to OBIS, ISO 8601; empty for old ones.
output.archive_url: Its Darwin Core Archive, to download every record.
output.dna_records: How many DNA-derived records it has.
output.doi: Its DOI or citation link, when it has one.
output.dropped_records: How many records OBIS left out for failing its quality checks.
output.event_records: How many sampling events it has.
output.extensions: Its Darwin Core extensions, such as 'measurementorfact'.
output.extent: The area its records cover, as a WKT polygon.
output.id: The dataset's OBIS ID, which 'Get a dataset' and the filters take.
output.license: Its license, as the publisher states it.
output.measurement_records: How many measurements or facts it has.
output.nodes: The OBIS nodes that published it.
output.occurrence_records: How many occurrence records it has.
output.processed_at: When OBIS last processed it, which is when new records reach OBIS.
output.published_at: When this version was published, ISO 8601.
output.records: How many of its records match the search; empty outside a search.
output.source_url: Its page on the publisher's IPT server.
output.tags: OBIS's tags on it, such as the environmental DNA tag.
output.title: Its title.

parameters.description: Only datasets published through this OBIS node. Leave blank for every node.
parameters.name: node

obis_new_records_trigger.description: Runs when a dataset in OBIS adds records of a species or other taxon, optionally only in one area: once for each dataset, with how many records it added. OBIS loads records a dataset at a time, a few times a day.
obis_new_records_trigger.display_name: New OBIS records of a taxon

output.added_at: When the dataset was first added to OBIS.
output.area_id: The area watched; empty for everywhere.
output.area_name: That area's name; empty for everywhere.
output.dataset_doi: The dataset's DOI or citation link, when it has one.
output.dataset_id: The dataset that added records, which 'Get a dataset' takes.
output.dataset_license: The dataset's license, as its publisher states it.
output.dataset_records: How many records of the taxon (in the area) the dataset holds now. 'Search occurrence records' with this dataset and taxon lists them, old and new together: OBIS gives every record a new ID each batch.
output.first_records: True when the dataset had no records of the taxon (in the area) before this batch.
output.nodes: The OBIS nodes that published the dataset.
output.processed_at: When OBIS processed the dataset, which is when these records arrived.
output.published_at: When this version of the dataset was published.
output.records_added: How many more records of the taxon (in the area) the dataset holds after this batch than before it: the records it gained, less any it lost.
output.scientific_name: The taxon watched, by its accepted name.
output.taxon_id: The AphiaID of the taxon watched.
output.total_records: How many records of the taxon (in the area) OBIS holds now.

parameters.description: One scientific name, such as Pterois miles, or its AphiaID. A genus or family covers every species in it.
parameters.name: taxon

parameters.description: Only records in this area: country waters, a sea area and so on. Leave blank for everywhere.
parameters.name: area
